content:
maya: Heads up, found a flaky repro in the Android sample: POSTs sometimes arrive with empty bodies after our Authenticator triggers a token refresh + retry. Repro is easier on low-RAM emulators.

jake: thanks for reporting. which OkHttp/Retrofit versions? any custom interceptors that read the body?

maya: OkHttp 4.9.3, Retrofit 2.9, Moshi. We have a debug interceptor that pretty-prints JSON by reading the request body for logs. Usually fine, but it looks like reading drains the internal buffer on some requestbody implementations.

kevin: that matches my experience. If a RequestBody is streaming (not backed by a byte[] or Buffer) then reading it consumes it and retries resend an empty body. OkHttp retries only work if the body is repeatable.

maya: here's the simplified chain I used in the sample:
```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .authenticator(TokenAuthenticator())
  .addInterceptor(DebugLoggingInterceptor())
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .build()

val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
  .client(client)
  .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
  .baseUrl(mockServer.url("/"))
  .build()
```

maya: DebugLoggingInterceptor logs body by calling `request.body?.buffer?.readUtf8()` which apparently drains on some Body instances.

jake: common pitfall. Two immediate fixes: 1) don't read body in interceptors (only log headers) or 2) replace request body with a buffered/byte[] backed variant so it can be replayed.

kevin: small utility we added in prod: BufferingRequestBody.wrap(original) -> if original.contentLength() <= MAX then read into Buffer and return RequestBody that reads from that buffer. That made retries reliable. Also avoid runBlocking in Authenticator (it blocks threads).

maya: good tip. I also noticed our TokenAuthenticator used runBlocking to call suspend refresh, which sometimes deadlocks in test harness. I changed it to sync refresh with OkHttp sync call to the auth service.

jake: for docs, we should mention: - Prefer sync refresh in Authenticator or a background refresh queue. - Avoid consuming request body in logging interceptors. - Provide BufferingRequestBody helper in sample. - Add MockWebServer test asserting body content is present after auth retry.

maya: will add a short section to the Android sample README and a tiny MockWebServer integration test that records requests and asserts the 2nd attempt has same body.

docs-team: please paste the README diff here when ready, we'll fold into the onboarding notes about SDK quirks (Retrofit/OkHttp).

android-ci-bot: CI for android/sample-app #491 triggered - test added: PostBodyRetryTest (mockwebserver)

maya: pushed branch with fix + test: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/android-samples/pulls/128 

kevin: nice work. also include a comment in the sample Authenticator impl pointing out threading concerns so users don't accidentally block their dispatcher.

maya: done, and added BufferingRequestBody util and example usage in the sample POST helper. Thanks for the help! :tada:
